Execute the Vietnam thermal generation inventory project. This is Turn 1 of Phase B. Your task this turn: conduct systematic web searches to build a comprehensive working list of Vietnam's thermal power plants (coal, domestic gas, imported LNG) above 30 MWe. Cover all lifecycle stages: operating, under construction, announced, permitted, shelved, cancelled, and retired. Search plan for this turn: 1. Search for PDP8 thermal power plant lists (coal and gas/LNG) — these contain the most comprehensive recent planning data. 2. Search for Global Energy Monitor Vietnam coal plant tracker and gas plant tracker — these are well-structured secondary sources that cite primaries. 3. Search for EVN annual report 2023 or 2024 installed capacity data. 4. Search for Vietnam operating coal power plants list. 5. Search for Vietnam LNG power plant projects. For each search, extract: plant name (Vietnamese + English), province, fuel, technology, capacity, status, COD, owner/developer. Output a structured working list organized by fuel type, noting which plants have strong source support and which need further verification in Turn 2. Flag any gaps or uncertainties for follow-up searches.
